summary: YY Group Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting a supplemental agreement with a holder of a convertible promissory note and warrants. Triggered by reverse stock splits causing a Floor Price Event, the holder elected redemption for $6,794,775.79 (125% premium). After partial payment of $5,428,323.29, the remaining $1,366,452.50 must be repaid by December 31, 2026, with 50% of ATM or subsequent financing proceeds allocated to repayment. The second tranche and warrants are cancelled. This is a routine debt amendment and repayment schedule, not a special situation. Watch for early repayment and any future financing requiring holder consent.
